name: property-deep-dive
description: Pre-purchase property due diligence across 126 countries — tax, risks, rental yield, visa, mortgage, building permits, schools, connectivity and 33 more sections per address. Detects the country from an address or listing URL, loads that country's playbook, and outputs a structured Markdown brief sourced to primary government registries with every figure dated and confidence-labelled. Docs at https://github.com/soreavis/property-deep-dive.
